symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings, like a target, on older leaves
Defoliation starting from the bottom of the plant and moving upward
Dark sunken lesions on stems near the soil line

severity_cues.early: Few spots, mostly on lower leaves
severity_cues.advanced: Spots on most leaves, heavy defoliation, stem lesions

favorable_conditions: Warm days (25 to 30 C), cool nights, dew and long wet periods, nutrient-stressed plants

treatment.summary: Remove affected leaves and start protective fungicide sprays on a fixed schedule
steps: Remove and destroy affected leaves away from the field, do not compost them
Spray Mancozeb 75 WG at 2.0 g per litre, repeat every 7 days
Avoid overhead watering and working in the field when leaves are wet
Keep the field weed free and improve air flow between plants

products.name: Mancozeb 75 WG
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

products.name: Chlorothalonil 75 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 g per litre as a protectant
Neem-based extract spray as per label
Longer crop rotation of 2 to 3 years and stake training to keep leaves dry

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection, tomato diseases
source.title: Tomato: early blight management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not harvest within 7 days of any fungicide spray
